headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: EBITDA grew 94.6% YoY to INR 89.7 cr, with margins expanding 30 bps YoY to 6.8%, while PAT increased 62.2% YoY to INR 48 cr, with PAT margin at 3.6%.
Sales volumes grew 25.6% YoY to 8,842 MT, while capacity utilization improved to 76% from 73% QoQ.
Specialized winding wires contributed ~74% of revenue, growing 87% YoY, while standard wires grew 119% YoY.
EBITDA per ton improved to INR 1,01,454 from INR 65,515 YoY, supported by higher CTC contribution, exports and operating efficiencies.
valuation: The company continued capacity expansion at Supa, with installed capacity reaching 43,445 MT as of June 2026 and targeted to increase to 59,045 MT by FY27 end.
Valuation call: We recommend HOLD at the CMP of INR 992, with a price target of INR 1,105 (22.6× FY29 earnings), representing an upside of 11.4% over the next 24 months.

Management targets a gradual increase in export contribution to its historical level of ~40% over the next few years, supported by new customer qualifications and higher wallet share. • Specialized winding wires continued to dominate the product mix, contributing ~75% of revenue, with segment growth of 87% YoY, while standard winding wires grew 119% YoY.
